finding: RSA readout reliability is cohort-dependent: the word-level neural RDM is reliable on the deep single-subject LibriBrain cohort but at the noise floor on the 10-subject MEG-MASC cohort, so RSA cannot rank models there.
implication: On MASC the neural RDM ceiling ~0.0024 bounds RSA alignment for every model near zero, so a reliable RSA ranking is not obtainable; encoding (which maps features to the response directly, not via a reproducible RDM) is tested separately (families_masc_persess.json).
